seedList.description: Required when runClass is 'reproducible'. When semantically inapplicable this field MUST be omitted, never filled with a placeholder; placeholder values (e.g. [0]) are a conformance failure of the submitting implementation. (RFC 017)

dataVersion.description: Required when runClass is 'reproducible' or 'analysis'. When semantically inapplicable this field MUST be omitted, never filled with a placeholder (e.g. "n/a"); placeholder values are a conformance failure of the submitting implementation. (RFC 017)

runClass.description: Class of the submitted run, not of the capability: 'reproducible' = stochastic computation where seeds and data versions both bind; 'analysis' = deterministic computation over versioned external data; 'operational' = data movement, instrument control, service calls. Conditional field requirements follow this class. (RFC 017)
